statement: The cellar door at Montalto is open seven days, from 11.30am to 4.30pm on weekdays and from 11am to 5pm at weekends.
note: Two records in this corpus asserted different hours for the same cellar door. The fact layer already carried the operator's split weekday and weekend hours; the venue record, which is the one that renders and emits openingHours into JSON-LD, carried a flat eleven to five across all seven days. The venue record was corrected to the operator's hours on this branch. Authored by hand for the PI-005 Stage 2 venue pilot. Sources were read on 2026-09-13; see ops/reports/claims/2026-09-13-pilot-venues.md.
